name: Cityscan
positioning: Everything around an address, scored — noise, pollution, transport, schools, risks, amenities — in one page.
description: Cityscan aggregates public and private data about the environment of a French address — transport, education, amenities, noise, air quality, natural and technological risks, planning projects — into scores and reports embeddable into professional products.
real_estate_use: Location quality is the argument every French listing makes and none evidences. Cityscan turns it into a scored report an agency can attach to a listing or a valuation, and that a developer or an investor can use to compare two sites. It also surfaces what a seller would rather not mention: a planned road, a flood risk, a nearby industrial site.
features: Environmental and amenity scoring per address
Transport, education and services accessibility analysis
Noise, air quality and pollution indicators
Planned urban projects near the address
Embeddable reports and widgets for professionals

use_cases.job: Evidence the quality of a location instead of asserting it in the listing text
Compare two candidate sites on environmental and risk criteria
